summary: Fixed bench-e2e "seedGraph: context includes secret" failure. Root cause: seedGraphOnArm called /overlay/edge and /overlay/status without workspace in the request body, so targetOverlay returned ws:null and the route 400'd, throwing before assertions ran. Fix: (1) pass workspace in body for /overlay/edge and /overlay/status, add &workspace= to /task/context query. (2) Remove SECRET from buildTaskBPrompt template vars (security leak — agents must get the secret only via get_dependency_summaries). Added invariant comment. (3) Added 3 new test assertions: OFF arm excludes secret, ON arm excludes secret, ON arm preamble includes get_dependency_summaries. All 18 tests now pass (was throwing before fix).
